messages:
Nora K: Hey folks, first day! Enrolled my company Mac into Jamf but the macOS update from 13.4 -> 13.5 keeps stuck on 'Preparing update...' in System Settings. Reboot doesn't help. Anyone seen this after MDM enrollment?

Devon (IT): welcome Nora :wave: sometimes a Jamf policy or a deferred update payload can block interactive installs. Can you run `softwareupdate --list` and paste output? Also, any MDM profiles installed? `profiles status -type enrollment`

Nora K: output: ```$ softwareupdate --list
No new software available.

$ profiles status -type enrollment
Enrollment: Enrolled via Jamf Pro
```

Devon (IT): hmm Jamf shows it's enrolled. If System Settings shows Preparing it might be waiting for a restart or a background installer stuck. Try checking /var/log/install.log for recent errors: `tail -n 200 /var/log/install.log | grep -i error` and paste any lines.

Nora K: I see a few lines: `error: authorization failed for package com.apple.macupdate, Authorization failed (1)` and another `package kit: failed to validate signature`. Not sure what that means.

Devon (IT): signature failures usually mean the update download got corrupted or MDM blocked the installer. Two quick options: 1) I'll trigger a Jamf policy to force a re-download and install (recommended). 2) We can clear cached updates and retry locally: `sudo rm -rf /Library/Updates/*` then `sudo softwareupdate --fetch-full-installer --full-installer-version 13.5` (this downloads the full installer and can be large). Do you want IT to push?

Maya (People Ops): IT push is fine for onboarding laptops — doesn't require approval. Nora if you need to keep working let us know and we can delay until off-peak.

Nora K: please push, Im on wifi here and prefer not to download 12GB over VPN.

Devon (IT): ok queued a Jamf re-download + install policy targeted at your device. Paste your hardware UUID if you want to confirm target (About This Mac -> System Report).

Nora K: UUID: 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3210-9abc-def012345678 (pasted). Thanks.

Deploy Bot: Policy "Force macOS 13.5 reinstall" queued for device 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3210-9abc-def012345678. ETA ~5 minutes.

Devon (IT): pushed. After policy completes, reboot and check System Settings -> General -> Software Update. If it still shows Preparing, ping here and we'll escalate to engineering.

Nora K: rebooted a few mins after the policy, update is installing now. Thanks so much! :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): welcome aboard Nora! Glad onboarding is moving along.

Nora K: all set, closing this thread.
